Gamle Oslo — Oslo, Norway

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Gamle Oslo is one of Oslo's 15 official bydeler (city boroughs). Oslo kommune's own police-sourced Statistikkbanken data recorded 9,499 reported offences with their place of occurrence here in 2024, across a population of 63,721 residents — a rate of 14,907 offences per 100,000 residents, roughly 1.6× the citywide bydel average. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central or nightlife/shopping-heavy bydel can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential bydel can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Oslo — real Oslo kommune Statistikkbanken figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Gamle Oslo safe?

Wandroz currently rates Gamle Oslo in Oslo, Norway as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Gamle Oslo safe at night?

At night, Gamle Oslo is rated as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Gamle Oslo a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Gamle Oslo's day rating (an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Gamle Oslo?

Not yet at neighbourhood level. Unlike London, this city does not currently publish an open, geolocated crime dataset at this level of detail (checked against the relevant local and national open-data portals — see the methodology page for what was checked).
